Coram : A.M. KHANWILKAR*, INDIRA BANERJEE, DINESH MAHESHWARI
Orissa Sales Tax Act, 1947 – ss.2(g),(jj) & 5(2)(AA) – Amendment in 1947 Act for levying sales tax on works contracts – Circular dated 04.11.1986 issued for reimbursement of sales tax paid by contractor in case of works contracts executed on or after 07.04.1984 on production – Works contracts executed by respondent no.1 – Sales tax levied for 1998-99 to 2000- 01 on the taxable turnover – Respondent claimed reimbursement – In the meantime, in view of another Circular, it was directed that no reimbursement of sales tax be made under Clause 45.2
Decision Date : 05-06-2020 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 2516/2020 | Disposal Nature : Dismissed | Bench : 3 Judges
